description: The tool lists NAICS industry codes with an industry page, the industry name, and the number of worksites with a page. You can filter by a word in the name or by the start of the code. The tool returns at most 50 rows in code order.

limit.description: How many results to return, 25 at most.

query.description: Worksite or company name, at least two characters.

name: list_industries
title: List industries
